money-and-cost.cash_card_notes: The local currency is the Burundian Franc (BIF). You’ll need approval to take more than BIF 200,000 out of the country. Some businesses may accept US dollars or euros. Exchange money only at authorised banks or reputable exchange bureaus to avoid counterfeit issues. Most bureaus may refuse to exchange older notes printed before 2013. ATMs are limited and unreliable. Most hotels and businesses don't accept credit cards. Bank transfers in and out of the country may not be available. Plan ahead. Have enough cash to meet your needs.

visa-preparation.entry_summary: A visa is needed. Register online on the incoming/outgoing passenger form before travel; the certificate it gives is needed to get the visa on arrival. A single-entry visa (1 month) can be obtained online, at Melchior Ndadaye International Airport or at embassies. Yellow fever certificate required.
visa-preparation.fastest_entry: Register the passenger form online, then get the single-entry visa online or on arrival at Bujumbura's airport.
visa-preparation.before_departure: Complete the online passenger registration (entry and transit) and keep the certificate; carry a yellow fever certificate. Burundi has no mission in Australia; the nearest embassy is in Tokyo.
visa-preparation.useful_stay: Single-entry visa: 1 month. Multiple-entry visa: up to 90 days, valid 1 month and renewable up to twice. Visas can be renewed in Burundi.

steps.step: Register on the incoming/outgoing passenger form before travelling (also required for transit) and keep the certificate.
Apply for the visa online, or obtain it on arrival at Melchior Ndadaye International Airport with the certificate.
Carry a yellow fever vaccination certificate and expect temperature checks on arrival (Ebola screening).
To stay longer, renew the visa with the Commissariat Général des Migrations in Burundi.

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Same-sex acts are illegal (3 months to 2 years in prison) and public affection draws negative attention. Largely cash-based: bring US dollars printed after 2006, undamaged. Cards are rarely accepted outside Bujumbura. Drug penalties are severe.
